notes:
v4.6.59 — IBKR cloud data now shows on the desktop + correct Period P/L

🐛 FIXED — IBKR bots showed "not connected" / $0.00 on this computer
• When your IBKR bots run 24/7 on the Oracle cloud, the desktop has no local gateway to read, so the Overview showed nothing even though trades were happening. The app now pulls each bot's live sub-portfolio (cash, holdings, value) from the server and shows real Portfolio / Cash / Positions in IBKR mode. (Fetched in the background so the UI never freezes.)

📊 FIXED — Period P/L now matches the period selector
• Period P/L means "change since the close one period ago": 1D = since the last close (so it now equals Day P/L), 1W = since the close ~7 days ago, etc. Previously it always showed bot-lifetime change with a different baseline than Day P/L. The card label now shows the selected period instead of "bot lifetime". Applies to both Alpaca and IBKR.

Update via the in-app banner.
